newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Davids sees yr net profit well down.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Davids sees yr net profit well down.

text.p: Grocery wholesaler and retailer Davids Ltd said on Wednesday its pre-abnormals full year profit would be substantially below analysts' forecasts of about A$48 million.
"It's down substantially from that," chief executive officer Don Bourke told Reuters.
"The bottom line is that the profit hasn't been satisfactory in the second half of the year," Bourke added.
Davids, which earlier announced a series of financial and organisational changes, posted a pre-abnormal profit for the first half of about A$27 million.
Its net profit in 1995/96 was A$51.8 million.
